scope: Source-only structural check, not compiled/behavioral qualification or a complexity metric.

functions.name: check_crt_request
functions.owning_contract: Validate finite probabilities in [0,1] and integer-indexed B/cell capacities before allocating any native bank. Endpoints, empty cells and B=0 are valid; these checks never shrink a request or replace its statistical mechanism.

functions.name: draw_wor_sample
functions.owning_contract: Native sampler streams are local Boost engines, independent of R draws. Generated Rcpp RNGScope behavior is unchanged: an absent R seed may be initialized at the wrapper boundary, but an existing R stream is not advanced. Reset scratch x to 0..n_tot-1, then perform M partial Fisher-Yates swaps. The selected ordered sample occupies x[n_tot-M..n_tot); callers preserve that extraction order. Scratch/i_doub_array have n_tot/M capacity, 0<=M<=n_tot. Advance the supplied Boost stream by exactly M uniform draws; no R RNG/state.

functions.name: fisher_yates_sampler
functions.owning_contract: Own one B-row bank of M distinct zero-based positions in the current fit universe [0,n_tot). Workers reuse prefixes/selected stages of this full bank; no source-cell IDs or R one-based positions enter it. Empty B/M is supported. Each call restarts Boost mt19937(4), preserving swap/extraction order without consuming R random draws. Guard sizes, protect/register a finalizing NULL XPtr, then allocate native storage; transfer ownership only after the whole bank is ready. R errors at the pointer boundary therefore cannot strand a live bank.
functions.actual_callers: R/get_synthetic_permutation_idxs; installed full-bank and safe-domain tests

functions.name: hybrid_fisher_iwor_sampler
functions.owning_contract: Full B-row bank for NT-control fits with N controls and treatment sizes m..M (N>=1, 1<=m<=M). Each stored row has M distinct zero-based positions; its size-k PREFIX, m<=k<=M, is valid in the N+k fit universe. A suffix can be outside a smaller current fit, so consumers must not validate/read the whole row as though it belonged to that smaller view. This prefix coupling is why one bank serves different guides instead of redrawing separately per guide. Preserve the initial Fisher-Yates extraction, inductive update order and fresh Boost mt19937(4) stream. No R draws/input mutation; NULL-XPtr-before-bank ownership and size/overflow guards are the same as fisher_yates_sampler.
functions.actual_callers: R/get_synthetic_permutation_idxs NT-control discovery; installed prefix/full-bank tests

functions.name: sample_crt_indices
functions.owning_contract: Bernoulli CRT bank: B variable-length rows of zero-based fit-cell positions. For each cell in input order, draw its number of inclusions with Boost binomial(B,p), then a Fisher-Yates subset of draw rows. Appending cells in this order preserves every full-bank draw and the original random stream; it is not equivalent to a row-major Bernoulli loop for seeded parity. Both CRT workers create the complete B1+B2+B3 bank once per guide and reuse it across responses; observed n_trt does not set synthetic row cardinality. Fresh Boost mt19937(4), no R random draws or input mutation. Protect the finalizing NULL XPtr before native allocation and attach ownership only on success.

functions.name: check_score_dimensions
functions.owning_contract: Shared score shape guard: a/w length n and D columns n. The Rcpp entry separately checks y/mu/observed cardinality. D rows may be zero; this does not revalidate a fitted model's rank or scan producer-owned bank coordinates.

functions.name: estimate_effect
functions.owning_contract: Ratio of treated sums y/mu and its existing residual-based standard error, both on the fold-change (not log) scale. y/mu share the fit-cell view; trt_idxs are zero-based, n_trt entries, in caller order (repetitions count). Degenerate sums/zero n_trt keep ordinary floating NaN/Inf. No mutation or RNG.

functions.name: null_score_segment
functions.owning_contract: Evaluate only bank rows [start_pos,start_pos+B), returning B ordered scores. Bank entries are already zero-based fit positions. Fixed-cardinality views read exactly n_trt entries per row; use_all_cells (CRT) instead uses the whole current row, whose length can differ from observed n_trt or be zero. Producers establish coordinate validity; check only selected row lengths/segment bounds, never a hybrid suffix that belongs to a larger fit. The complete bank remains const and reusable across responses/stages. No draws, input mutation or RNG.

functions.name: observed_positions_zero_based
functions.owning_contract: Allocate an owned vector preserving observed order/repetitions and subtract one once. Positivity/NA is checked here; the Rcpp entry checks upper bounds. The caller's R vector is never decremented in place.

functions.name: observed_score
functions.owning_contract: Studentized efficient score: sum(a[T]) / sqrt(sum(w[T])-||sum(D[,T])||^2). D is nuisance-columns x fit-cells, T is zero-based and already validated by the owning boundary. Preserve summation order, including repeated positions; no clamping/new fallback for a zero or negative studentizer. Inputs read only.

functions.name: association_result_record
functions.owning_contract: Wrap numeric components into the real R result schema p/z_orig/fc/se/stage/ sn_params, optionally resampling_dist. Copy only the selected owned segment; never serialize/copy a bank pointer. No numeric transformation or mutation.

functions.name: evaluate_staged_tail
functions.owning_contract: Consume disjoint segments of the already-generated full bank: B1 at offset 0, B2 at B1, B3 at B1+B2. Stage 1 uses add-one empirical tails; p<=.02 reaches optional skew-normal stage 2. A declined/failed fit uses empirical stage 3. B3=0 deliberately retains the previous selected segment (B2 if fitting was attempted, otherwise B1), including its fitter-produced sorting/reversal. Only reached B2 needs the fitter's >=100 observations. No stage redraws or concatenates earlier samples. Output owns its last segment; bank stays const, missing SN parameters stay NA and existing sidedness/floor conventions stay. No RNG or file effects; selected-stage validation errors propagate unchanged.

functions.name: check_for_outliers
functions.owning_contract: Existing two-tail extreme/normal-envelope ratio gate (threshold 1.5). Input is the nonempty ascending selected segment; endpoint ratios and even degenerate divisions retain original arithmetic. The const segment is neither sorted nor changed by this gate.

functions.name: check_sn_tail
functions.owning_contract: Goodness-of-fit check on an ascending right-tail representation (>=100). At probabilities .90,.905,...,.99, compare the recorded order statistic with fitted upper-tail probability; a ratio >2 declines the fit. The owning fitter supplies sorted/possibly sign-reflected data and enforces the length bound.

functions.name: compute_empirical_p_value
functions.owning_contract: Inclusive empirical exceedances with add-one numerator/denominator: side -1 left, +1 right, otherwise twice the smaller tail. Ties count in both tails; two-sided p can exceed one and is intentionally not clamped. Empty segments retain the same formula. Scores are read only and no RNG is used.
functions.actual_callers: evaluate_staged_tail; two-sided recursive calls; component bridge

functions.name: fit_and_evaluate_skew_normal
functions.owning_contract: Own the optional tail fit on a selected segment of at least 100 scores. Reject nonfinite moments/outliers/poor selected-tail fit with p=-1; stages then apply the existing empirical fallback. Accepted p uses requested side and is floored at 1e-250. Return xi/omega/alpha/p, even on a declined fit. Sorting is in place on this owned segment. A left-tail check reverses and reflects it, then restores signs only, so returned segment order can remain descending. Preserve that observable order; never touch the full draw bank. Short reached segments fail clearly; no RNG, R callbacks or file effects.

functions.name: fit_skew_normal_funct
functions.owning_contract: Moment fit on the selected segment: return location/scale/shape plus sample mean and population SD. Keep original moment/summation order: skewness >.995 is replaced by .9*.995; no new symmetric cap or degenerate-fit repair. Nonfinite parameters are handled by the owning fitter's existing empirical fallback.

functions.name: run_association_test
functions.owning_contract: Sole Rcpp association boundary. y/mu/a/w have n ordered fit cells and D is nuisance-columns x n; observed trt_idxs are R one-based positions and n_trt is their observed cardinality. Validate dimensions/positions/budget arithmetic before converting observed positions exactly once. Empty/degenerate numeric fits retain their existing NaN/Inf arithmetic rather than a new fallback. synthetic_idxs is a live worker-local XPtr owning a zero-based full DrawBank; validate its address, then borrow it const. Fixed-size tests use n_trt prefixes; CRT tests use each selected row's entire cardinality, including empty rows. Return the unchanged effect/score/tail schema, optionally the last selected null segment. Components allocate their own result and never mutate inputs or the bank; no RNG or file effects. This is not a persisted pointer format.
functions.actual_callers: Four R/association_workers.R workers; prepared native/index/safety tests

functions.name: check_group_size
functions.owning_contract: Calibration needs nonempty NT guides and 1<=group_size<=active NT count. Guard enumeration/sampling before indexing or allocating; no metadata fallback.

functions.name: draw_wor_sample
functions.owning_contract: Distinct zero-based NT-guide subset in draw order, using caller-owned std mt19937/uniform state and O(n) scratch. Caller establishes 0<=k<=n. This std stream belongs to calibration; it is deliberately not the Boost bank stream.

functions.name: increment_group_indices_in_place
functions.owning_contract: Convert an explicitly owned scratch combination matrix from zero-based NT guide positions to R one-based label positions. MUTATES the supplied matrix, preserving shape/member/row order; the R calibration constructor calls this only after sampling has finished with the zero-based representation.
functions.actual_callers: R/construct_negative_control_pairs, after zero-based sampling and before labels

functions.name: iterate_over_combinations
functions.owning_contract: Enumerate all size-k subsets of active NT guides into a group x member zero-based integer matrix. Preserve the current next_permutation visitation order (including its first step/wrap), rather than sorting output rows. Check choose(n,k), dimensions and capacity before filling. No RNG/mutation.

functions.name: positive_integer
functions.owning_contract: Double-valued count guard before narrowing to native int; finite, integral, positive and within capacity. This does not choose a smaller feasible request.

functions.name: sample_calibration_groups
functions.owning_contract: Sample a bounded set of distinct unordered NT-guide combinations, returning group x member integer matrix with zero-based active-NT-guide positions. Group count is min(choose(n,k), max(threshold,ceil(5*pairs/(p_hat*genes)))); validate empirical p_hat and capacity before narrowing/allocation. Each subset is sorted for uniqueness; result rows follow the existing unordered_set iteration order, not a newly imposed order. Fixed std mt19937(4), no R draws or input mutation. Preserve rejection/draw order and the existing heuristic.

functions.name: sample_calibration_pairs
functions.owning_contract: Sample QC-eligible group/response pairs without replacement. Count matrix is active-NT-group x all-response; possible_groups_m is candidate-group x member, with ZERO-based row positions in that matrix. Summing member counts is correct for low-MOI/disjoint groups or the caller's precomputed union row; high-MOI overlap must be unioned before entry. Totals share response columns. Enumerate candidates by group*n_genes+response, traverse a fixed std seed-4 partial Fisher-Yates stream and retain shared legacy_pair_eligible outcomes. Return one-based response/candidate-group positions plus counts in acceptance order; may exhaust before requested pairs. Widen/check products and sums before allocation/narrowing. Inputs read only, thresholds inclusive, no R RNG; do not replace this stream/eligibility policy with a new acceptance heuristic.

functions.name: compute_genes_within_distance
functions.owning_contract: Supplied chromosome positions need not be sorted. Return their one-based input positions satisfying the inclusive distance predicate, in input order. Widen before subtraction so valid signed integer coordinates cannot overflow. Negative thresholds retain an empty result; missing/unrepresentable native coordinates fail clearly. Inputs are read only and no RNG is used. Count before allocating the exact R result: no native-owned result buffer is alive across R allocation/return wrapping, and no full-length scratch is needed.

functions.name: evaluate_pair_eligibility_cpp
functions.owning_contract: Vector R boundary for the shared eligibility rule. Aligned integer treatment/ control counts retain input order and duplicates; validated scalar thresholds come from QC settings. Return logical with FALSE dominating NA as in R's original vector comparisons; source vectors are read only, with no RNG.
functions.actual_callers: R/evaluate_pair_eligibility policy boundary; NA/shared QC tests

functions.name: legacy_pair_eligibility_value
functions.owning_contract: Preserve the old R vector predicate's missing-value behavior here too. Native calibration counts are complete; the vector boundary supplies R's NA sentinel.

functions.name: legacy_pair_eligible
functions.owning_contract: The existing observed-count policy. Sampling uses this in its unchanged candidate stream; discovery uses the vector adapter in pair_eligibility.cpp. Counts and validated scalar thresholds share count units, with inclusive >=. "legacy" names the deliberately fixed statistical policy, not a retired alias.

functions.name: bank_extent
functions.owning_contract: Check the requested nested-vector shape and total int payload for representable allocation, including empty rows/banks. No allocation or random draws here.
functions.actual_callers: Fisher-Yates/hybrid/CRT request guards before native bank allocation

functions.name: matrix_extent
functions.owning_contract: Check a nonnegative rows x columns result against R length and native integer vector allocation capacity before creating its R matrix. No feasibility guess.
functions.actual_callers: Calibration group sampler/enumerator before matrix allocation

functions.name: nonnegative
functions.owning_contract: Native integer domain check (R NA_INTEGER is negative). Failure precedes arithmetic/allocation; zero is supported where the caller permits it.

functions.name: register_bank
functions.owning_contract: The finalizing NULL-address pointer must already be protected before the native bank is allocated. Creating/preserving/registering an XPtr may raise an R error that bypasses C++ destructors; this final transfer cannot allocate.
functions.actual_callers: The three retained bank producers; final nonallocating ownership transfer

functions.name: sum
functions.owning_contract: Nonnegative int addition via int64_t, returning int only after range check; used for stage offsets and hybrid universe sizes, never to cap budgets.
functions.actual_callers: Hybrid universe sizes; association/stage budgets; selected bank segment end

functions.name: checked_group_count
functions.owning_contract: Guard list length before narrowing dimensions to native int. Empty groups are a supported zero-row output; no group contents or count policy changes.

functions.name: copy_zero_based
functions.owning_contract: Pure C++ helpers make no R calls; native allocation exceptions unwind their owners. Repetitions/order survive the sole one-based-to-zero-based copy.

functions.name: copy_zero_based_groups
functions.owning_contract: Own every ordered group after R preparation. Convert each one-based position once, retaining repeated memberships (including NT sums) and empty groups. Only pure C++ allocation/copies occur while these native owners are alive.

functions.name: load_stored_positions
functions.owning_contract: CSR slots are valid zero-based Matrix coordinates. Presence includes stored zeros/fractions. Source and analysis scratch belong only to this native scope.

functions.name: prepare_groups
functions.owning_contract: Coerce each R group to integer once and root it in normalized before native ownership. Trivial PositionViews use R_alloc; an R longjmp during coercion or validation cannot strand std::vector storage. Groups index the analysis view.

functions.name: prepare_positions
functions.owning_contract: Borrow/materialize an integer R vector of one-based coordinates, validating [1,limit] and int length. Preserve order/repeats; do not subtract or mutate. Its protected normalized R owner must outlive the later compute scope.

functions.name: response_count
functions.owning_contract: Obtain all-response dimension from CSR pointer length, checking representable source/analysis sizes. Canonical CSR layout/slot consistency is the storage adapter's precondition; this is not a second sparse-layout validator.

functions.name: sparse_group_counts
functions.owning_contract: Group x all-response stored-position counts, using the same private loader. Normalized inputs and the complete matrix exist before owned native copies; the compute-only scope ends before return. Empty views retain zero dimensions and counts; storage selects/repeats columns later. No input mutation, count-value loading, RNG, or file effects.

functions.name: sparse_pair_counts
functions.owning_contract: Fused all-response summaries and requested pair counts from valid CSR slots. R one-based groups index the ordered cells_in_use analysis view directly; requests are response-sorted and storage restores their original row order. NT totals SUM groups, including overlap; complement totals count analysis cells. Coercion/materialization and named R results precede owned native copies. Their compute-only scope ends before return, including on exceptions. No input mutation, count-value loading, eligibility, RNG, or file effects.

functions.name: compute_cell_covariates_cpp
functions.owning_contract: Feature-by-source-cell CSC summaries: i/p/x are canonical zero-based slots, n_genes rows/n_cells columns; output vectors follow original cell order. Column summaries load values (not stored-position counts): nonzero means value > 0.5. UMIs sum all loaded values, including fractional counts; optional mito fractions use R one-based feature rows. Optional max-feature returns a zero-based first strictly maximal row; all-zero columns keep row 0/NaN ratio. Unrequested optional fields remain their allocated zeros. Active mitochondrial indices are copied from R one-based rows only after all R allocation/materialization, including the named result. The native compute scope uses cached pointers and ends before return. Source i/p/x and all R inputs remain unchanged; preserve ties and zero-total ratios.

functions.name: compute_n_grnas_per_cell_vector
functions.owning_contract: Count guide memberships per cell from a list of R one-based cell positions in the caller's n_cells view. Order/duplicates are not normalized: repeated memberships contribute repeatedly. Inputs have already been validated by the assignment path. Returns a new zero-initialized integer vector, no RNG/mutation.

functions.name: load_csr_row
functions.owning_contract: Dense numeric row in original source-cell order from valid CSR j/p/x. row_idx is R one-based, converted once for load_sparse_vector; n_cells is full source width. Returns a new vector, retaining loaded values and implicit zeros; storage selects/reorders requested cells afterward. No input mutation.

functions.name: load_sparse_vector
functions.owning_contract: Load one zero-based compressed segment into caller-owned dense scratch out (length dim), resetting it first. Slots/pointers are canonical zero-based Matrix CSR/CSC coordinates; adapters establish valid layout and dimensions. Explicit zero/fractional VALUES are loaded; no threshold or stored-position counting occurs. Canonical segments have unique indices (otherwise last wins). Mutates only out, never source slots, and allocates nothing/no RNG.

functions.name: obtain_pointer_vector
functions.owning_contract: Build dim+1 zero-based compressed pointers from an already nondecreasing stream of zero-based major indices in [0,dim). Empty rows/columns get repeated offsets; dim=1 uses all entries. Import/storage callers establish sorted valid coordinates before entry. Repetitions remain stored entries, not coalesced. Returns a new vector, with no mutation, value inspection, RNG or file effect.

functions.name: threshold_count_matrix
functions.owning_contract: Threshold the STORED values of one CSR feature row (R one-based row_idx). Return R one-based source-cell positions in segment order for x>=threshold; explicit zeros can qualify at threshold<=0, but implicit zeros are not visited. Compare numeric fractions directly; no integer conversion or deduplication. Two passes allocate an exact result; source j/p/x and caller vectors unchanged.

source_contract_coverage: 49 retained named implementation functions in 13 reviewed native files, including inline header helpers; plus inference interface declarations/record views and one named cis lambda.

src/pair_construction_functs.cpp: within_distance: read-only int64 inclusive predicate, validated native signed coordinates, no reordered output

Root-owned EM contracts, separately reviewed; excluded from this worker coverage.
Generated registration/bindings; regenerated atomically with R counterpart after quiet release, not handwritten C1 scope.

necessary_retained_complexity: Hybrid coupled prefixes serve N+k fit views; one whole-row validation or ordinary single-universe shuffle would change laws.
Full B1+B2+B3 banks retain stream/order and cross-response reuse; selected segments are not redrawn/concatenated.
CRT observed and synthetic cardinalities differ, including empty synthetic rows; fixed-size permutations select a prefix only.
Skew-normal fit retains asymmetric moments, selected tail tests, original thresholds and sorted/descending returned segment; B3=0 keeps prior selected segment.
NULL finalizing XPtr protection precedes native bank allocation; final bank transfer cannot allocate across the R longjmp boundary.
Count preparation roots/materializes normalized R views before pure native ownership; native owners leave scope before any later R wrapping.
Stored-position sparse counts (including zero/fractional stored entries and repeated memberships/NT sums) differ from loaded-value >0.5 cell summaries and stored-value threshold comparisons.
Calibration enumeration, subset rejection order/unordered_set row order and fixed std RNG candidate stream are observable; statistical legacy_pair eligibility is a real retained policy.
Compressed loaders/pointer builders remain real representation primitives called by storage/import; no replacement aliases or new sparse validation framework.
